release: Installed 2023.05.31; official 2023-05 tag; exact binary-to-commit rebuild identity not claimed

findings.GenerateMesh_lines_1490_1505: Boundary-layer generation is nested under surface_mesh_flag; disabling this flag does not provide a supported layer-generation bypass.
findings.GenerateSurfaceRemesh_lines_1955_1989: use_mmg=False selects the existing native VMTK surface path; TetGen remains the volume mesher. MMG path sets size band 0.4h..1.2h and default hausd=8h; Python exposed options have no Hausd control.
findings.VMTKUtils_lines_949_984: Uses target triangle area and projects remeshed surface back to original input. This constrains vertices, not finite-facet cylinder error.

conditional_P2_configuration.reason: One official alternative removes the MMG size-band policy and uses original-surface projection. Geometry/BC QA must still pass; success is not assumed. No mesher replacement or adapter rewrite.
